# SKY HIGH FLYING CANINES

> > Professional disc dog training and canine fitness services specializing in online coaching and video review for performance dogs.

SKY HIGH FLYING CANINES offers disc dog training programs, online video review services, and showcases their team of performance dogs including rescue athletes. The site provides resources for canine fitness and competitive disc dog training.

## Key Topics

- Disc dog training
- Online coaching and video review
- Canine fitness
- Performance dogs
- Rescue dog athletes
- Training feedback
- Chihuahua mix performance
- Orange County Animal Shelter
- Payment options (Venmo, Zelle, PayPal)
- SKY HIGH FLYING CANINES team
- Competitive disc dog sports

## Training Services

- [Online Training Video Review](https://flyingcanines.com/services/training/training-video-review): Online disc dog training video review service (currently closed)

## Team Dogs

- [Rebel](https://flyingcanines.com/dogs/rebel): Profile of Rebel, a Chihuahua mix rescue from Orange County shelter
